usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.beta.threads.runs.create("thread_id", assistant_id="string", include=["step_details.tool_calls[*].file_search.results[*].content"], model="string", reasoning_effort="none", instructions="string", additional_instructions="string", additional_messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "string", "attachments": [{"file_id": "string", "tools": [{"type": None}]}], "metadata": {"key": "string"}}], tools=[{"type": "code_interpreter"}], metadata={"key": "string"}, temperature=1, top_p=1, stream=True, max_prompt_tokens=1, max_completion_tokens=1, truncation_strategy={"type": "auto", "last_messages": 1}, tool_choice="none", parallel_tool_calls=True, response_format="auto")
print(result)

typeReference.signature: client.beta.threads.runs.create(thread_id, assistant_id, model=..., reasoning_effort=..., instructions=..., additional_instructions=..., additional_messages=..., tools=..., metadata=..., temperature=..., top_p=..., stream=..., max_prompt_tokens=..., max_completion_tokens=..., truncation_strategy=..., tool_choice=..., parallel_tool_calls=..., response_format=..., include=...) -> RunObject

fields.name: assistant_id
fields.description: The ID of the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) to use to execute this run.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The ID of the [Model](/docs/api-reference/models) to be used to execute this run. If a value is provided here, it will override the model associated with the assistant. If not, the model associated with the assistant will be used.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Overrides the [instructions](/docs/api-reference/assistants/createAssistant) of the assistant. This is useful for modifying the behavior on a per-run basis.

fields.name: additional_instructions
fields.description: Appends additional instructions at the end of the instructions for the run. This is useful for modifying the behavior on a per-run basis without overriding other instructions.

fields.name: additional_messages
fields.description: Adds additional messages to the thread before creating the run.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: Override the tools the assistant can use for this run. This is useful for modifying the behavior on a per-run basis.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

fields.name: top_p
fields.description:
An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

We generally recommend altering this or temperature but not both.

fields.name: stream
fields.description: If `true`, returns a stream of events that happen during the Run as server-sent events, terminating when the Run enters a terminal state with a `data: [DONE]` message.

fields.name: max_prompt_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of prompt tokens that may be used over the course of the run. The run will make a best effort to use only the number of prompt tokens specified, across multiple turns of the run. If the run exceeds the number of prompt tokens specified, the run will end with status `incomplete`. See `incomplete_details` for more info.

fields.name: max_completion_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of completion tokens that may be used over the course of the run. The run will make a best effort to use only the number of completion tokens specified, across multiple turns of the run. If the run exceeds the number of completion tokens specified, the run will end with status `incomplete`. See `incomplete_details` for more info.

fields.name: include
fields.description:
A list of additional fields to include in the response. Currently the only supported value is `step_details.tool_calls[*].file_search.results[*].content` to fetch the file search result content.

See the [file search tool documentation](/docs/assistants/tools/file-search#customizing-file-search-settings) for more information.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `thread.run`.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run was created.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: The ID of the [thread](/docs/api-reference/threads) that was executed on as a part of this run.

fields.name: assistant_id
fields.description: The ID of the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) used for execution of this run.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the run, which can be either `queued`, `in_progress`, `requires_action`, `cancelling`, `cancelled`, `failed`, `completed`, `incomplete`, or `expired`.

fields.name: required_action
fields.description: Details on the action required to continue the run. Will be `null` if no action is required.

fields.name: last_error
fields.description: The last error associated with this run. Will be `null` if there are no errors.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run will expire.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run was started.

fields.name: cancelled_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run was cancelled.

fields.name: failed_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run failed.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the run was completed.

fields.name: incomplete_details
fields.description: Details on why the run is incomplete. Will be `null` if the run is not incomplete.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model that the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) used for this run.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: The instructions that the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) used for this run.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The list of tools that the [assistant](/docs/api-reference/assistants) used for this run.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: The sampling temperature used for this run. If not set, defaults to 1.

fields.name: top_p
fields.description: The nucleus sampling value used for this run. If not set, defaults to 1.

fields.name: max_prompt_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of prompt tokens specified to have been used over the course of the run.

fields.name: max_completion_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of completion tokens specified to have been used over the course of the run.
